upravniOdbor.subtitle: President
upravniOdbor.textperson: Regulatory compliance expert with a background in financial supervision, now fully engaged in driving progress in the crypto sector.
Nikola Škorić is the founder and CEO of Electrocoin Ltd., which operates the leading Croatian cryptocurrency exchange and payment system Paycek.
Entrepreneur who loves new and unexplored things. Actively working on product and ecosystem development and as a partner in the MCC blockchain startup fund.
Vlaho Hrdalo is a lawyer who focuses on fintech, blockchain, and cryptocurrencies in his professional and scientific work.

Antonio is a cofounder and CEO at Locastic, a product development company from Croatia working with clients worldwide. He also cofounded and started the BlockSplit conference, one of the most prominent blockchain events in our region.

Bringing 10 years of crypto research to life through on-chain analysis and data-driven tools. I build on-chain inflation indexes, DeFi insights, and market dashboards that help investors and teams act fast.
